findings.text: the fixture seeds no stored sprint status anywhere, so the gate cannot tell a pointers-only read from one that also consults the stored marker — a rewrite that ORs the stored status into the verdict, the stale-marker defect the plan opens with, passes every assertion here — and the control offered as the guard reads docs/sprints/<id>.html through parse_meta, whose status is a default for this repository's sprint documents (probe: parse_meta of the real docs/sprints/S24.html returns 'draft' while that document's own status block reads 'open'), so its red comes from the stored input being absent rather than from a marker disagreeing with the pointers; seed a sprint document whose stored status is active with no live pointer and assert it reads live false.

item_verdicts.done_when: the gate the done_when names is tests/test_sprint_liveness.py, and it asserts every clause of the measure — two sprints live with their run and session counts (:144, :147-149), a third whose only pointer is terminal reading false (:157-160), and a no-write window over the synthetic config home and docs tree (:135-141) — and I reproduced the green at the reviewed head in my own run (recheck-gate.log: 2 passed, module.__file__ inside the reviewed tree).

item_verdicts.manifest: read the reviewed run's manifest — it states the gate result at base 4079c4d2, the declared mutation with its log and its failing assertion, both commits, the changed paths, and the plan-comment hand edit it bypassed /reckon-edit for; each of those reproduces at the reviewed head, and the manifest is complete.
